lines: Beparda nazar aayin jo kal chand biwiyan
couplets.en: Yesterday I saw a few women out unveiled.

lines: Poochha jo maine, aap ka parda woh kya hua?
Kehne lagin ke aql pe mardon ki pad gaya.
couplets.en: When I asked where their veil had gone, they said it had fallen over the minds of men.

lines: Niklo na benaqaab.
Niklo na benaqaab, zamana kharaab hai.
couplets.en: Do not go out unveiled, for the world is unkind.

lines: Niklo na benaqaab, zamana kharaab hai.

couplets.en: Do not go out unveiled with youth in such bloom, for the world is unkind.

lines: Sab kuchh hamein khabar hai, naseehat na kijiye.
